identity.title: Reactor SCRAM due to Low Electro-Hydraulic Control Pressure

cause.proximate_text: The Unit 2 SCRAM on low EHC pressure was caused by the failure of three of four ASTM A574 grade 4137 black oxide coated mounting cap screws for shutoff valve BFN-2-FCV-047-0154C...ultimately failed due to hydrogen embrittlement. Hydrogen embrittlement could have been introduced from environmental sources (plant environment, improper cleaning, improper lubricant, etc.), or during the manufacturing process (black oxide coating).
cause.theme: hydrogen embrittlement of mounting cap screws (environmental or manufacturing origin, undetermined)

nodes.role: control system for turbine, source of the leak

nodes.display_name: Mounting cap screws (ASTM A574 grade 4137, black oxide coated)
EHC pressure surge from placing B pump into service
nodes.description: EHC system pressure increased ~54 PSIG (~3.5%) when alternate EHC pump B was placed into service for testing; within operating limits but most likely initiating event.
Three of four mounting cap screws on 2-FCV-047-0154C failed due to hydrogen embrittlement, breaching the EHC pressure boundary.

nodes.display_name: EHC pressure boundary breach / tank drained
nodes.description: Breach of the EHC pressure boundary at the shutoff valve drained the Unit 2 EHC tank, causing significant EHC leak and loss of system pressure.
Turbine bypass valves failed closed due to loss of EHC pressure following the leak.

nodes.display_name: Turbine trip and automatic reactor SCRAM on low EHC pressure
Second automatic RPS actuation due to low reactor water level transient

properties.triggering_action: manual opening and closing of a main steam relief valve

nodes.display_name: Replace shutoff valve and mounting cap screws
CAPR 2012739-005: change procurement strategy of mounting cap screws to QA3 with added documentation/testing
CAPR 2012739-007: revise procedures to align with vendor manual VTD-G080-3255 (cleaning, reuse, lock washers, lubrication)

chain: EHC pressure surge from B pump start [cause TBD, hydrogen embrittlement] -> mounting cap screws shear on 2-FCV-047-0154C -> EHC pressure boundary breach / tank drained -> turbine trip & reactor SCRAM (also: turbine bypass valves fail closed) -> second RPS actuation from low reactor water level transient
notes: Cause code left TBD/provisional per FORM-366 fields, though narrative extensively discusses hydrogen embrittlement of mounting cap screws as proximate mechanical cause (source - environmental vs. manufacturing - undetermined). No SSCs were inoperable prior to the event; no BACKED_UP_BY edges emitted since bypass valve failure and RPS actuation were consequences, not backups. Feedwater pump and main steam line drains used post-trip for level control/decay heat removal are operator response actions, not stated pre-event backups for a failed system-so not modeled as BACKED_UP_BY. No previous similar events reported per Section VII, so no stub LER/SIMILAR_TO edge emitted. Manufacturer for cap screws is generically coded QA0 (non-safety related) per Block 13.D; no distinct Manufacturer entity/edge created since a manufacturer name/code beyond category code QA0 is not given.
